description: Verify any Solana mint against the NEET narrative: returns CANONICAL (it is the real NEET, Ce2gx9KGXJ6C9Mp5b5x1sn9Mg87JwEbrQby4Zqo3pump), CLONE (it trades on the NEET name but is a different contract; the canonical contract is named in the verdict), or NOT_NEET. Registry-driven: registered clones resolve by address even when the token is dead and has no market data. This is the anti-scam check to run before buying, quoting, or routing to anything named NEET: ticker copies are industrial-scale on Solana and at least one aggregator has mislabelled a dead clone as the official contract. Independent tooling, not affiliated with the NEET token or its team. Cost: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (Base settlement; Solana settlement when configured).

mint.description: Any Solana mint address (base58, 32-44 chars) to check against the NEET narrative, e.g. 9MaKE8AQW2HjsQjLYgvkXc8PEWTQ43t5qj9Gc9VEpump (a known clone) or the canonical Ce2gx9KGXJ6C9Mp5b5x1sn9Mg87JwEbrQby4Zqo3pump.

name: neet_verify
